'''Morbo's Paradise''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] and bar located within the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The casino was owned by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Morbo]]. Behind it lay a warehouse containing storage for Morbo's illegal goods and private office. Morbo's Paradise was equipped with advanced security equipment.

==History==
In [[3640 BBY]], the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Theron Shan]] visited the place and was confronted by Morbo's [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Bouncer (occupation)|bouncers]] while searching for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prisoners of war.
